question.text: The radius of a calcium ion is $94 \mathrm{pm}$ and of the oxide ion is $146 \mathrm{pm}$. The possible crystal structure of calcium oxide will be

solution.text:
As per formula,
$$
\begin{aligned}
\text { radius ratio } & =\frac{\text { radius of cation }}{\text { radius of anion }} \\
& =\frac{94}{146}=0.643
\end{aligned}
$$
Since the value is between $0.414-0.732$ hence the coordination no. will be 6 and geometry will be octahedral.
